projects.title: pop2mat demo reconstruction
projects.note: 45 variables reconstructed from the bundled tests/data/pop2mat.txt fixture (aracne + bayes_hc, presFreq 0.3). Carries the spectral subgraphs, so the coverage heatmap works. Regenerate with: curl -X POST localhost:8788/run -F data=@tests/data/pop2mat.txt -F methods=aracne,bayes_hc -F thresh=0.3 -o web/demo.graph.json
